published_prior_art.cite: HuWager2022 gives geometric-mixing burn-in rates, not a fixed-array polynomial-envelope minimax theorem over all sequential kernels.

BojinovSimchiLeviZhao2023 and YuMaLiu2025 optimize specified finite-order models; ZengEtAl2026 covers no- and first-order carryover, not simultaneous adaptation over the proposed infinite-memory class.
BojinovSimchiLeviZhao2023 already treats the no-carryover fixed-array switchback regime; this is a useful sanity reduction rather than a standalone novelty kernel.
GoldenshlugerLepski2011 and DuchiRuan2021 provide generic adaptive-selection and constrained-risk tools, not this sequential fixed-array adaptation-index question.

novelty_flags.label: thm:oracle-rate / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The review omits the close single-aggregate-unit carryover design paper XiongChinTaylor2024 (arXiv:2406.06768), which derives a switch-frequency carryover bias--variance decomposition and should be positioned explicitly.

novelty_flags.label: thm:oracle-rate
novelty_flags.one_line: HuWager2022 is invoked for the claimed geometric-mixing comparison without a theorem, section, or equation anchor for the asserted burn-in tradeoff.

novelty_flags.label: thm:adaptive-oracle
novelty_flags.one_line: The first-order scope comparison to ZengEtAl2026 has no section/theorem anchor despite being a flagship-adjacent comparator.

soundness_flags.label: def:multiscale-design
soundness_flags.one_line: The schedule is defined to record run arms, yet the construction then conditions on that schedule while assigning each run-start arm probability one-half; conditional on recorded arms those probabilities are degenerate.

soundness_flags.label: def:multiscale-design
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed exact conditional randomization variance proxy cannot be computed from (W,Yobs,S_T): enumerating alternative run-arm coins requires their unobserved potential outcomes, so the stated GL penalty is not data-measurable.

soundness_flags.label: thm:adaptive-oracle
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem depends on ass:finite-order-carryover while claiming uniform performance over the whole polynomial class, including arrays outside every fixed-order class; the finite-order condition belongs only to the strict-inclusion subclaim.

source_verification_receipts.version: Management Science 69(7), 2023; primary theorem text inaccessible in this review
source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher bibliographic record; corroborating pre-publication text, Theorem 2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper exists at the cited venue and studies minimax switchback design under specified carryover orders; its exact published theorem pagination should be checked before making formula-level comparisons.
The paper is a multi-unit framework with spillover and a specified m-carryover assumption, and develops minimax design plus Horvitz--Thompson inference.
Under Markovian geometric mixing, standard switchbacks have T^{-1/3} error while burn-in yields O(sqrt(log(T)/T)).
The paper uses clustered switchbacks under graph interference and rapidly mixing hidden-Markov temporal interference, proving near-1/(NT) MSE rates.
SRSB treats no carryover and a first-order-carryover extension, with outcome-history-based rerandomization.
The paper develops an Ls-risk oracle-inequality selection rule that is adaptive over anisotropic Nikol'skii classes.
The paper proves a constrained-risk inequality for general non-decreasing losses and adaptive/superefficiency lower-bound arguments.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Redefine S_T to contain only run lengths (or separate the arm-coin sigma-field), then give p_{t,b,a} conditional on that information and replace v_b by a computable B-based concentration bound or a separately proved conservative variance proxy.
Remove ass:finite-order-carryover from the global adaptive theorem and state the finite-order intersection/witness assertion as a separate corollary with that condition only where needed.
Add XiongChinTaylor2024 and precise theorem/section anchors for HuWager2022 and ZengEtAl2026; distinguish their model-based or finite-order targets from the proposed fixed-array polynomial class.

After repairing the implementable selector, add a design-based limit-law and variance-estimation/coverage target for the selected estimator to make the experimentation contribution operational rather than rate-only.

recommended_next_step: Revise the multiscale design into a genuinely data-measurable randomized procedure, repair the finite-order dependency, and expand the anchored switchback literature comparison before Stage 0.
